text: Testing plays a vital role in creating reliable software. Developers use unit tests to check small parts, like a single function, to ensure they work correctly. Meanwhile, integration tests verify that different parts of the system communicate and cooperate as expected. Some programmers follow test-driven development, where they write a failing test first, then write code to make it pass, step by step. Although this process takes extra time at first, it builds strong confidence. As a result, developers can make changes or add new features without fear of breaking existing functions. In short, testing is not a boring chore; it is a safety net that keeps software strong and dependable.
